claims.claim: Source-REPAIR reads and validates the fixed policy blob from the exact canonical failed candidate and matches the transported failed-RUN profile to the requested identity before dispatch.

The validated policy is carried through REPAIR profile resolution, durable dispatch replay and admission, continuation profile persistence, and RUN binding; ordinary REPAIR retains repo-local policy validation and the dispatch record schema is unchanged.
Source-REPAIR rejects missing or invalid candidate policy, mismatched failed-RUN lineage or profile, unsupported effort, and conflicting dispatch selectors before Executor invocation.
Production source-REPAIR activation is set to None; source-PRIMARY and bootstrap activation constants and target-consumption guards remain unchanged.

The portability document records the pre-RUN admission failure and the required publication, separate activation, new delivery identity, and downstream continuation sequence without claiming RUN-255-004 or BP-9 completion.
